name: Tofu Stirfry
author: Justin Esposito
steps: Press the extra firm tofu for 30 mins, the less liquid the better
Cut tofu into rectangles with ~half a pinky width & an index finger length
With a rice cooker, cook 1 cup of rice
In a pan spray lightly with oil & add tofu
Flip the tofu's once they are golden brown
Once the veggies are stir fried, add in asian sauces
[optional sauce 1] 2 table spoons of seasame paste 2 table spones of chili crips 4 table spoons of soy sauce
[optional sauce 2] 1 parts soy sauce 1 part teriyaki sauce
